Kadget Remote for Android — control your Mac running Kadget from your phone over Tailscale.

Install: download the APK on the phone and allow installing from this source. Then on the Mac open Kadget › Tools › Kadget Remote, turn it on and scan the code.

## Changes

- fix(remote-app): "can't reach the Mac" no longer blames Tailscale alone
- chore: 3.5.0 (Kadget Remote 1.5.0) on the branch; MEMORY.md covers Kadget Cloud and Tools 4
- fix(remote-app): every pairing exit that saves nothing gives the Mac's token back
- fix(cloud-phone): a No sends the token only over the pairing's live connection
- docs(cloud): the phone loopback tunnel's accepted residual
- fix(cloud-phone): pairing again replaces the old token silently; No revokes an issued token
- fix(cloud-phone): a stream starting on a shared tunnel keeps a failed hello's reason
- fix(cloud-security): keep paired phone names with their digits; pairing questions stay in view
- fix(cloud-reliability): phone relay tunnel listens only while used, probes long enough, reports the right reason
- fix(cloud-security): the phone keeps a relay pairing only after it confirms the code
- feat(remote): delete the Kadget account from Settings, the password asked again
- fix(remote): signed-out relay-only Macs say so, a relay sign-out ends the account, crypto errors stay inside the stream
- feat(remote): Kadget account screens, Connect over the relay, and the route in the session
- feat(remote): account state, routes and relay pairing
- feat(remote): AccountApi and the relay end-to-end proof against the Go backend
- feat(remote): RelayTunnel, a loopback port to a Mac through Kadget Cloud
- feat(remote): KTun1 in Dart, the phone role, byte for byte with the shared vectors
